headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Mooring, Stonecradle Stir
war_summary: Fresh returns to 03:15 put the Weathered Expanse at the head of the wire with 11 seizures in six hours, 30 in the day about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, now standing six Warden to three Colonial holds. Mooring County breaks quiet with three seizures to 02:57 about The Cut and The Wind Hills for five in the day at ten Warden to two Colonial on 6,145 Colonial and 4,588 Warden day losses. Stonecradle adds three in six hours to 00:58 about Buckler Sound and World's End for ten in the day, now four Warden to five Colonial. Farranac Coast, busy in the last edition, records four in six hours but none in the last two since 00:40 about Transient Valley and The Bone Haft for nine in the day at one Warden to ten Colonial. Fisherman's Row with 14 in the day, Linn Mercy with nine about Lathair, The Gutter with five about The Parras and Stlican Shelf with five about Thornhold show no seizures in six hours, while Callahans Passage and Nevish Line still carry heavy day losses without a flip in the day.
